meta.notes: BrokerPass's own document-completeness checks. Not derived from a RECO bulletin; these cover the 'dates, initials and signatures' promise. Every rule is AI-judgment against the uploaded PDF. v2: removed BP-PKG-07 (deal type is detected by the scanner, not selected).

rules.requirement: Every party signature the form requires for the deal to be binding (buyer, seller, tenant, landlord; spouse consent where the form shows a spouse is involved) is present. Witness lines are optional and never required. Electronic signatures (DocuSign, Authentisign and similar stamps or typed-script signatures with a timestamp) count as signatures.
rules.applies_when: Any form in the package has signature lines.
rules.detection_signal: A required PARTY signature line is blank, or a party named in the form has not signed. Ignore blank Witness lines entirely. Ignore blank Acknowledgement / receipt-of-copy blocks unless the form is an APS and neither side acknowledged.
rules.fix_guidance: Obtain the missing signature(s) from the named party before submitting.
rules.notes: Report each missing party signature with the form, page and party. Never report blank witness lines; they are optional on OREA forms and are always blank on e-signed packages.

rules.rule_name: Initials present on every page that requires them
rules.requirement: Where a form provides initial boxes at the foot of each page, every page carries the initials of every party.
rules.applies_when: Any form in the package provides per-page initial boxes.
rules.detection_signal: Perform the page-by-page initials audit: on each page with initial boxes, check every party's box individually. One or more boxes empty on any page = failed. An empty oval with no marks inside is empty even when the other party's box on the same page is initialed.
rules.finding_template: Initials are missing on one or more pages.
rules.fix_guidance: Have each party initial every page where initials are missing.
rules.notes: List each page and which party's initials are missing.

rules.requirement: An offer's irrevocability clause states both a date and a time (with a.m./p.m.).
rules.applies_when: The package contains an offer, counter-offer or amendment with an irrevocable clause.
rules.detection_signal: The irrevocable date or time field is blank, or the time lacks a.m./p.m.
rules.finding_template: The irrevocable date or time is blank or incomplete.
rules.fix_guidance: Complete the irrevocable date and time before presenting or accepting.
rules.notes: Without a time the irrevocable period is unenforceable.

rules.requirement: Offer date, acceptance date, completion/closing date, condition deadlines and any possession or occupancy dates are filled in and do not contradict each other (e.g. a condition deadline after closing).
rules.applies_when: Any dated agreement is in the package.
rules.detection_signal: A required date is blank, or dates are mutually inconsistent.
rules.finding_template: A key date is blank or inconsistent.
rules.fix_guidance: Fill in the missing date, or correct the sequence so every deadline falls in a sensible order.

rules.requirement: Every page of each form is present, in order, and readable. No page is blank, cut off, rotated beyond reading or too low-resolution to read.
rules.detection_signal: A numbered page is missing from the sequence ('Page 3 of 6' present, page 4 absent), a page is unreadable, or the document is not a real estate form package at all.
rules.finding_template: The package is incomplete or has unreadable pages.
rules.fix_guidance: Re-scan or re-export the affected pages and re-upload the complete package.
rules.notes: If the upload is clearly not a deal package (e.g. a random PDF), report this rule as critical and mark every other rule not applicable.

rules.rule_name: Parties and property consistent across forms
rules.requirement: The property address and the names of the parties match across every form in the package.
rules.applies_when: The package contains more than one form.
rules.detection_signal: The address or a party name differs between forms (beyond obvious abbreviation).
rules.finding_template: Property or party details differ between forms.
rules.fix_guidance: Correct the form(s) so the address and party names match exactly.
